#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;

LL n, A[20], B[20], ans;

void dfs(int pos, LL now, LL res) {
    if (res >= ans) return;
    if (pos == 0) {
        if (now == 0) ans = res;
        return;
    }
    LL t = now / A[pos];
    LL d = (t >= 0) ? t - 1 : t + 1;
    LL s = (t >= 0) ? t + 1 : t - 1;
    dfs(pos - 1, now - t * B[pos], res + abs(t) * pos);
    dfs(pos - 1, now - d * B[pos], res + abs(d) * pos);
    dfs(pos - 1, now - s * B[pos], res + abs(s) * pos);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    B[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i) B[i] = B[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
    A[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= 16; ++i) A[i] = A[i - 1] * 10;
    cin >> n;
    LL m = n;
    int c = 0;
    while (m) {
        ++c;
        m /= 10;
    }
    ans = 1e18;
    dfs(c, n, 0);
    dfs(c, B[c + 1] - n, c + 1);
    cout << ans << '\n';
    return 0;
}
